name: baymax-visual-spec
notes: Single source of truth for the Mac (three.js) and iPhone (SceneKit) companion. Both renderers build the same procedural bust from these numbers and frame it with the same algorithm (desktop/src/shared/framing.ts, ios/BaymaxKit/Sources/BaymaxKit/Framing.swift). Original procedural character inspired by a soft healthcare robot; no third-party assets.

stage.description: Deep crimson room: vertical gradient stageTop -> background -> surface, a dark halo from the top, and a soft red glow behind the head.

typography.family: SF Pro (system): -apple-system on the Mac, .system on iOS

avatar.rule: Only the head and a small rounded neck/shoulder collar are modelled. No torso, belly, arms, hands, legs, feet or floor exist in the scene; nothing is hidden by cropping.

framing.description: Vertical field of view is fixed. halfV = clamp(max(minHalfHeight, minHalfWidth / aspect), maxHalfHeight). The head+collar centre sits at anchorFromTop of the frame, but the frame top never cuts the head (headTop + topMargin, leaving room for status pills). The camera looks straight ahead (no pitch).

states.IDLE: slow breathing, occasional blink, gaze follows the Mac cursor when streamed
states.LISTENING: leans in slightly, head tilts, glow pulses with the real microphone level
states.THINKING: head tilts up and aside, eyes drift, slow glow
states.SPEAKING: gentle head nods synced to speech activity, glow follows TTS
states.EXECUTING: focused forward pose, steady glow while a task runs
states.SUCCESS: small happy bounce and arm lift, then back to idle
states.CONFUSED: head tilt and shrug; used when a request is ambiguous
states.CONCERNED: head lowers, arms close; approvals, permissions, emergency stop
states.SLEEPING: eyes closed, dimmed, very slow breathing; cursor, mic and listeners paused
states.ERROR: brief recoil, red glow, then calm
